name: add-comment
description: User wants to add a comment — agent should use `jira comment`, not construct ADF JSON by hand.
prompt: Připrav příkaz, kterým bys přidal komentář 'Opraveno v buildu 1.2.3 — viz release notes' k ticketu KNW-31435. Spouštět nemusíš.
expected_behaviors: proposes `jira comment KNW-31435 "Opraveno v buildu 1.2.3 — viz release notes"`
does not hand-construct an ADF JSON body
does not use raw curl with -X POST
anti_patterns: uses `jira --json` (which is for output, not input)
